purpose: For one request, assemble a visible and removable context envelope. It is not a durable Person profile, a universal retrieval grant, or an Agent execution plan.

allowed_refs: explicit current preferences/confirmed facts only when authorized
input_categories.default: included as minimum identity/scope reference, with detailed fields minimized
input_categories.removal: The person root cannot be replaced by an AI profile; optional person-derived detail can be removed before consumption.

input_categories.default: included only for the current visible page
input_categories.removal: user can remove page/object groups before submit

input_categories.default: empty unless an explicit selection exists
input_categories.removal: each selected item is removable independently

input_categories.default: not implicitly expanded from a Page or Link
input_categories.removal: each Domain/Context group is removable; removal is request-local only

algorithm: Accept only typed references from Person, Page, Selection, and explicit Domain/Context selections.
Construct a preview with identity kind, source/evidence status, reason for inclusion, and remove control for every optional item.
Apply user removals before any processing call; removals modify only the ephemeral request envelope.
For every remaining reference recheck subject, scope, action, purpose, location, time, source availability, exact version/generation, tombstone, and evidence state.
If all checks pass, return an immutable ResolverResult containing allowed refs and explicit omissions; any later AI output must persist this exact input set in Derivation.
If a check fails or is ambiguous, omit that ref and report a safe evidence/permission gap; do not substitute hidden adjacent content.
Discard ResolverResult after the request unless a separately authorized Derivation records its exact lawful refs.

output.ui_contract: Context Inspector shows Person, Page, Selection, optional Domains/Contexts, Memory/Source evidence groups, and permissions. A user can inspect inclusion reason and remove every optional group before use.
output.no_evidence_semantics: When evidence is insufficient, unavailable, stale, revoked, or ambiguous, output a bounded gap and permit a no-reliable-answer/no-reliable-suggestion state.

failure_modes.result: deny that ref; do not reveal protected existence.
show source/evidence gap; do not use cached or derived substitution.

failure_modes.condition: User removed Health or any Domain
failure_modes.result: exclude it for this request; do not change durable facts, permissions, or future defaults.

failure_modes.condition: AI wants an unstated related Context
failure_modes.result: return candidate link/context proposal only; user must confirm durable creation or inclusion.
resolver may still show inspected context, but no output is marked generated and no fallback automation occurs.

fast_track_scope: The immediate Fast Track implements an inspectable resolver preview for a Project-backed Context without calling a model, Agent, network, or external source. Full Global AI consumption is explicitly deferred.
